# Ash Marshall — Corporate Video Director & Filmmaker (London)

> London-based videographer and director creating cinematic corporate films, brand content and music videos for UK and international clients. 140+ films delivered for brands and publishers including Microsoft, HP, Property Week, Money Marketing and Packaging News.

Ash Marshall is a London-based director and producer known for capturing how an event or place actually felt (the buzz of an awards night, the character of a location) and for putting interviewees and customers at ease on camera. He runs projects end to end, from idea and shoot through edit, colour, sound and delivery, and finds a way to get them made whatever the brief or budget. Corporate and brand storytelling is the core of the practice today, with a growing focus on music video direction.

## Services
- Event and awards films that capture the atmosphere of the night
- Interviews and customer stories, with people at ease on camera
- Brand and product films that make complex ideas simple
- Music video direction
- Photography & design

## Selected clients & work
- Microsoft — Surface device showcases, Copilot workforce films
- HP — ProBook product films
- Gonvarri — Hackathon 2024 event film
- Property Week, Money Marketing, Packaging News, Industry Retail News, Motor Trader, Exhibition World — interviews, awards coverage and roundtables
- ISE / InfoComm 2019 — 50 trade-show interviews and features
- 140+ films in total across corporate, product and event work

## Short film
Electra (2016) — a university short film that won Best Direction, Best Sound Design, Best Production Design and Best Concept.

## Approach
One person from first conversation to final delivery: concept, direction, cinematography, lighting, edit, colour grading and sound. Time is spent before recording putting contributors at ease, so they sound like themselves.

## Location & availability
Based in London, United Kingdom. Available for commercial and creative briefs across the UK and internationally.
